items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 Camel.isFood = #camel_food (cactus; the tag exists in the jar's data and prepared block-tags.json). Port food_tag() (mobs/species.rs:1633) covers CamelHusk but NOT Camel; 'camel_food' appears nowhere in the port, so MobType.food is empty for camel and feeding/breeding/tempting never fire. Camels cannot breed. Carried over unchanged from 1.21.7.
items.title: Camel has no food — camels cannot breed

items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 Armadillo.getMaxHeadYRot = isScared() ? 0 : 32. Port species.rs:1712 returns 32.0 unconditionally, although the port HAS armadillo::scared(m) state (mobs/armadillo.rs:160). Carried over unchanged from 1.21.7.
items.title: Armadillo scared head rotation ignored (vanilla: 0 when scared, 32 otherwise)

items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 Mob.isSunBurnTick excludes isInWaterOrRain || isInPowderSnow || wasInPowderSnow; port sun_burn_tick (mobs/ai.rs:2033) checks only in-water / in-rain although Mob has in_powder_snow state (mobs.rs:1617, updated ai.rs:1413-1414). A skeleton standing in powder snow burns in the port, not in vanilla. Carried over unchanged from 1.21.7.
items.title: Sun-burn ignores powder snow (vanilla excludes isInPowderSnow || wasInPowderSnow)

items.evidence: Vanilla 26.2 NaturalSpawner.getRandomPosWithin: top = getHeight(WORLD_SURFACE)+1, y = randomBetweenInclusive(minY, top) -> [minY, H+1]. Port (spawn_category_for_chunk, mobs/spawn_selection.rs:1117): y = min + nextInt(top-min+1) where top = heightmap(WorldSurface) = H -> [minY, H]. Port never picks the top value and consumes a different nextInt bound, so the RNG stream diverges for every spawn attempt. Carried over unchanged from 1.21.7.
items.title: getRandomPosWithin y-range off by one (port never picks H+1; RNG stream diverges)

systemic_note: No systemic thread in 26.2's Batch 3. The 1.21.7 batch's three systemic threads are all resolved for 26.2 by the version itself: (1) 26.x tag/form leakage — 26.2 IS a 26.x version, so the tags, data formats, items and APIs the port carries exist in vanilla 26.2 (G03 immune tags, G14/G15 teleport grounding, G16 data-driven trades, G21 iron spear all check out); the port was written against 26.2's own jar under the vanilla-check rule. (2) Goal-cadence conversion — 26.2 vanilla HAS reducedTickDelay/adjustedTickDelay, so the port's reduced() is correct here (G17). (3) RNG-stream divergences — G13 fixed (unconditional draw), G02's form is vanilla's; only G11's y-range bound remains, a single-site off-by-one, not a pattern. The four remaining port gaps (G05, G06, G09, G11) are independent single-site omissions carried over from 1.21.7, and the two driver gaps (G19, G20) are stale 26.3 constants. The oracle groups (B3-O01–O05) are all 26.3-form stubs (fuelValues, LocalPlayer ctor, 26.3-only methods/symbols) failing against 26.2's API — mechanical repairs, not port defects.
